scope: Independent review of the primary frozen results and saved per-cell records. No new window, rate fit, biological hypothesis test or joint-refinement calculation.

checks_and_pins.scope: Finite recorded-roster primary envelopes only; no population null inference, effect-size fit, window selection, or joint-refinement output.

method.source_rosters: Reconstructed strict baseline eligibility from pinned source graph and event annotations. Original-workbook roster reconciliation was already verified in implementation-review.json; the graph and workbook hashes remain unchanged.
method.path_mass: Separate iterative path-frontier calculation with fractions.Fraction. Each missing biological daughter retains half the incoming weight. Production mass/ratio/contrast code was neither imported nor called.
method.ratios: Independent exact rational calculation across all optional inclusion counts, converted to float only for comparison.
method.contrasts: Independently re-evaluated the frozen marginal-difference interval and nesting cap for every fixed pair and evaluation time.
method.common_U: Every node mass vector is identical across the three saved selection-horizon groups for the same baseline/offset/policy/time.
method.sensitivity: Checked per-cell interval, ratio, and contrast containment under whole_episode versus first_issue, plus offset1 versus offset0 survival-bound order. No unsupported monotonicity of conditional ratios across death offsets was assumed.
method.checker_publication_status: Packaged after primary results and after the independent review run; byte-identical to the executed local reviewer calculation. No scientific tuning or new empirical calculation during packaging.

findings: No missing or duplicated fixed-grid cases, node records, or mass-query times.
All source-derived rosters are identical across all horizons and sensitivities for a given baseline; no additional at-or-before-baseline apoptosis exclusions occurred.
All saved values match independent recalculations exactly; maximum observed error and conservation residual are zero.

All 300 primary contrast intervals include zero exactly and at tolerance 1e-12. The 60 time-zero intervals are [0,0] by construction, leaving 240 nontrivial evaluation-time comparisons that also include zero.
No ratio case has an undefined or potentially zero denominator under the recorded-source relaxation.
interpretation_limits: Zero containment is a feature of these conservative finite-record envelopes. It neither proves no effect nor validates population horizon invariance.
The rectangular marginal and separate-horizon relaxation may include incompatible histories; these results do not prove fundamental nonidentifiability.
No confidence level, population p-value, biological efficacy estimate or patient conclusion follows.
Original cohort eligibility, independent experiments, replicate labels and uncertain annotations remain unresolved. Different baseline cells may share ancestry.
The treatment-origin bracket and two death offsets are explicit sensitivity choices; they are not a resolved time dictionary.
prospective_next_action: Use the separately frozen joint-refinement plan on every one of the same 300 cases, preserving these primary outputs and the source/observation limits. If the refined relaxation still contains zero, report that result without changing windows or calling it proof of no effect. Any attempt to identify population dynamics needs an explicit cohort/annotation route beyond interval tightening.
review_timing: Post-primary-results independent validation, not a pre-results registered scientific analysis.
